violations.why: The ISR can overwrite v_pylon after the task's check at line 52. The task then writes 0 at line 53 based on a stale value.
The ISR can change v_pylon between the task's check at line 52 and its later read at line 30. The two reads can see different values.
The ISR can overwrite the value the task stored at line 63 before the task reads it at line 52. Interrupts are not masked.
After the task resets v_pylon to 0 at line 53, the ISR can write a new value. The read at line 30 then copies that value into v_falcon instead of the reset one.
